# jupyternotebook
📊 Machine Learning Models – Jupyter Notebook
📌 Overview

This repository contains Jupyter Notebooks designed to help understand and implement various Machine Learning models from scratch and using popular libraries. It is aimed at beginners and intermediate learners who want hands-on experience with real datasets.

🚀 Objectives
Understand core concepts of Machine Learning
Implement different ML algorithms step-by-step
Learn data preprocessing and feature engineering
Evaluate model performance using metrics
Visualize results for better understanding
🧠 Models Covered
Linear Regression
Logistic Regression
Decision Trees
Random Forest
K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)
Support Vector Machines (SVM)
(Optional) Neural Networks Basics
🛠️ Technologies Used
Python 🐍
Jupyter Notebook 📓
NumPy
Pandas
Matplotlib / Seaborn
Scikit-learn
📂 Project Structure
├── data/                 # Datasets used
├── notebooks/            # Jupyter notebooks for each model
├── models/               # Saved trained models (optional)
├── requirements.txt      # Dependencies
└── README.md             # Project documentation
⚙️ Installation
Clone the repository:
git clone https://github.com/your-username/ml-models-notebook.git
cd ml-models-notebook
Install dependencies:
pip install -r requirements.txt
Launch Jupyter Notebook:
jupyter notebook
📊 Workflow
Data Collection
Data Cleaning & Preprocessing
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
Model Selection
Training the Model
Evaluation (Accuracy, Precision, Recall, etc.)
Visualization of Results
📈 Example Results
Achieved high accuracy on classification datasets
Visualized decision boundaries and feature importance
Compared multiple models for performance
📚 Learning Outcomes

By completing these notebooks, you will:

Gain practical ML experience
Understand when to use which model
Improve problem-solving skills in data science
